title: Tom DeLonge books on official and non-government programs

tellings.quote: you read the Tom Deong books, he sort of points to this idea of there essentially being, you know, official government programs and then non-government programs.

plain: Matthew Pines, a researcher and analyst, says on a podcast that the books of Tom DeLonge, a rock musician who later founded a company to study UFOs, point to two kinds of secret UFO work. According to Pines, DeLonge describes official government programs on one side and programs outside the government on the other. If so, it would mean some of this work sits beyond normal public oversight.
